fields.label: From Date (AD)
fields.description: Resolved from the BS month and the payroll period basis in Nepal HRMS Settings.

fields.label: Actual Days
fields.description: True length of this period before the override.

fields.label: Use This Many Days
fields.description: Divisor to use for per-day deductions in this period instead of the actual day count.

fields.label: Applies From
fields.description: Only salary slips created on or after this date use the override. Slips already calculated keep the divisor snapshotted on them, so historical pay is never restated.

fields.label: Reason
fields.description: Why this period is being overridden. Shown on the audit trail.
